response.sql:
WITH filtered_executions AS (
  SELECT ordersmark, remaincount
  FROM orderexecutions
  WHERE expirespot >= '2025-02-28 08:29:46.10496'
    AND expirespot <= '2025-03-13 08:29:46.068533'
),
order_stats AS (
  SELECT ordersmark,
         AVG(remaincount) as avg_remaincount,
         COUNT(*) as exec_count
  FROM filtered_executions
  GROUP BY ordersmark
)
SELECT AVG(avg_remaincount) as avg_of_averages,
       SUM(exec_count) as total_executions
FROM order_stats
WHERE avg_remaincount IS NOT NULL

assumptions.assumption: "Number of executions" per order means the count of all execution records (COUNT(*)), not just those with non-NULL remaincount

alternatives.interpretation: "Number of executions" counts only executions where remaincount is not NULL
